title: 第3章 伪萝莉
slug: 次元论坛全本免费-次元论坛最新章节列表
content_zh:
【回复：专业解决由黄毛、巨洳、自言自语、学识丰富及女装癖等引起的交友困难，欢迎进入私人板块咨询，我们非常专业！——回复人：邻人部部长】
关立远总觉得如果真听了这家伙的话，可爱的“将成为火影的男人”就更加找不到朋友了！
出于对论坛自带的“邀请拜访”功能的垂涎，关立远也主动和“将成为火影的男人”接触过几次，不过现在这不是重点，重点是讲台上正在对自己咆哮的老头……
“熊老师，您别和这未来的奴才一般见识，他要自甘堕落，您何必同他置气呢？”一名看起来有点小帅的黄毛马上对老讲师说道。
这小黄毛看起来比关立远大了三四岁的样子，不过略显清秀的五官，却难掩眼神中的阴厉之色。
“嗯，贡文你这次考得不错，可以在毕业前，再进行一次模拟试炼，加上你之前的积累，‘开灵’成功的可能性很大，希望你会觉醒一系实用的职业，将来做一名对联盟有贡献的职业者！”熊老师说道。
“我的心愿其实就是能够觉醒成为‘风元素使’，那就心满意足了！”
熊老师更加满意的笑了起来……因为他就是一名“风元素使”！不过几十年过去，还只是中阶职业者，年纪大了之后，就锐气已丧的在学院做讲师了。
看着这一老一小，在那相互吹捧，关立远不由得一阵反胃……
没错，这位小黄毛贡文，正是“买下”了关立远的田贡好的后台、贡氏家族的少爷！
不过现在关立远之所以没有出言嘲讽，并不是因为顾忌贡文，而是已经认识到，这位熊讲师本来就不是要脸的人，嘲讽也没有用。
比如刚刚就为了能有个在贡氏家族少爷面前露脸的机会，找了个由头就训斥关立远一顿……
讲师中哪个不知道关立远的情况？交白卷不是正常的吗？
但是熊有亮就是能够厚着张脸皮，装作不知道！
关立远没有出声，熊有亮还想要继续说什么，不过却被一声冷哼打断了。
熊讲师听到这声音，却微微一滞，虽然表情略有不耐，但是却没有继续说下去。
“熊老师，那你觉得我‘开灵’成功的几率有多大？”刚刚冷哼出声的人开口说道。
居然是名萝莉？
不对！仔细看起来的话，应该是一名个子比较小的女生！
虽然是坐着，但是也大概能够看出，这位站起来之后应该也就一米三几的样子……

除了身高之外，一头及腰的栗色长发，还有两只若隐若现的虎牙，也格外引人注目。
但是与她的个子、和看起来很精致的五官不同的是，脸上的表情显得痞气十足，甚至只要看一眼，就会让人本能的联想到“不良少女”。
不过在她开口之后，刚才还一副“我与差生势不两立”的架势的熊有亮，硬挤出一丝笑容说道：“钟离小姐既然在‘开灵’之前，就已经半觉醒，当然是肯定能够‘开灵’成功的！而且十有八九会继承钟离家族的‘虎斗士’职业，成为一名强大的职业者……”
熊有亮有心讨好贡氏家族，而贡文也喜欢学院中有一名讲师帮衬自己的感觉，所以两人自然一拍即合、狼狈为奸。
但是钟离秋所在的钟离家族，与贡氏家族一样，都是杜兰城的大家族，而且钟离秋在“开灵”仪式前，就已经半觉醒，在杜兰城这一届的年轻人中，天赋是数一数二的，只是钟离秋的脾气秉性，继承了钟离家族的“耿直”，熊有亮根本没有讨好她的机会……
他可以为了让贡文少爷出气，而毫不犹豫的贬低关立远一顿，但如果同时还要得罪钟离秋的话，他就要想一想了。
毕竟回头被钟离家族套麻袋的时候，贡氏家族未必愿意为了他这么一个、根本不是自己人的家伙出头……
为什么贬低关立远，反而是讨好贡文少爷的行为？他不是贡氏家族的准家奴吗？
这就要从一个月之前说起了，一开始田贡好让关立远插班到贡文少爷身边，一来是因为贡文少爷这届马上就要毕业了，同时也是为了让贡文少爷在学院多个使唤的下人！
毕竟基础教育学院都是强制寄宿的，在学院内也不能有家奴跟着……
小主子，这个章节后面还有哦 ^.^，请点击下一页继续    喜欢次元论坛请大家
content_en:
[Reply: Professionally solve the difficulties in making friends caused by yellow hair, giant hair, talking to oneself, rich knowledge, cross-dressing, etc. Welcome to the private section for consultation, we are very professional! ——Replyant: Minister of Neighborhood Department]
Guan Liyuan always felt that if he really listened to this guy, the cute "man who will become Hokage" would be even less able to find friends!
Out of coveting the forum's built-in "invite visit" function, Guan Liyuan also took the initiative to contact the "man who will become Hokage" several times, but this is not the point now, the point is the old man who is roaring at him on the podium...
"Teacher Xiong, don't be like this future slave. He is willing to degenerate. Why should you be angry with him?" A handsome yellow-haired man immediately said to the old lecturer.
This little yellow guy looks to be three or four years older than Guan Liyuan, but his slightly delicate facial features cannot conceal the sinister look in his eyes.
"Well, Gongwen, you did well in the exam this time. You can take another simulation trial before graduation. With your previous accumulation, you have a high chance of success in 'opening the spirit'. I hope you will awaken a series of practical professions and become a professional who contributes to the alliance in the future!" Teacher Xiong said.
"My wish is actually to awaken and become a 'Wind Elementalist', then I will be completely satisfied!"
Teacher Xiong laughed even more with satisfaction...because he is a "Wind Elementalist"! However, decades later, he was still a mid-level professional. When he got older, he lost his energy and became a lecturer in the college.
Seeing the old and the young complimenting each other, Guan Liyuan couldn't help but feel nauseous...
That's right, this little Huangmao Gongwen is the young master of the Gong family who "bought" Tian Gonghao's backstage from Guan Liyuan!
However, the reason why Guan Liyuan did not taunt him now was not because he was worried about Gong Wen, but because he had realized that this lecturer Xiong was not a face-seeking person in the first place, and sarcasm was useless.
For example, just to have a chance to show his face in front of the young master of the Gong family, he found an excuse to scold Guan Liyuan...
Which lecturer doesn't know about Guan Liyuan's situation? Isn't it normal to hand in a blank paper?
But Xiong Youliang is able to be shameless and pretend not to know!
Guan Liyuan was silent. Xiong Youliang wanted to continue saying something, but was interrupted by a cold snort.
When Professor Xiong heard this voice, he hesitated slightly. Although his expression was slightly impatient, he did not continue.
"Teacher Xiong, what do you think are the chances of me successfully 'opening up my spirit'?" the person who just snorted said.
She's actually a lolita?
wrong! If you look closely, she should be a smaller girl!
Although he is sitting, it can be roughly seen that this person should be only about 1.3 meters tall when he stands up...
In addition to his height, his waist-length chestnut hair and two looming tiger teeth are also particularly eye-catching.
But unlike her stature and delicate-looking facial features, the expression on her face is full of ruthlessness. Even just one look at her will make people instinctively think of a "bad girl".
However, after she spoke, Xiong Youliang, who just now had the attitude of "I am at odds with Cha Sheng", forced out a smile and said: "Since Miss Zhongli has been semi-awakened before she 'opened her spirit', of course she will definitely be able to 'open her spirit' successfully! And there is a high probability that she will inherit the Zhongli family's 'Tiger Fighter' profession and become a powerful professional..."
Xiong Youliang was determined to please the Gong family, and Gongwen also liked the feeling of having a lecturer in the college to help him, so the two naturally hit it off and worked together.
However, Zhongli Qiu's Zhongli family, like the Gong family, is a big family in Dulan City. Moreover, Zhongliqiu was already semi-awakened before the "spiritual opening" ceremony. Among the young people of this generation in Dulan City, his talent is one of the best., it’s just that Zhong Liqiu’s temperament has inherited the “uprightness” of the Zhongli family, and Xiong Youliang has no chance to please her...
He could belittle Guan Liyuan without hesitation just to make Master Gongwen vent his anger, but if he wanted to offend Zhong Liqiu at the same time, he would have to think about it.
After all, when they were sacked by the Zhongli family, the Gong family might not be willing to stand up for someone like him who was not one of their own at all...
Why is it that belittling Guan Liyuan is an act to please Master Gongwen? Isn't he a quasi-slave of the Gong family?
This started a month ago. At the beginning, Tian Gonghao let Guan Liyuan join Master Gongwen. This was because Master Gongwen was about to graduate this year, and also to allow Master Gongwen to have more servants in the academy!
After all, basic education colleges have compulsory boarding, and domestic slaves are not allowed to follow them in the college...
Little master, there will be more after this chapter ^.^, please click on the next page to continue. If you like the Dimensional Forum, please
